extraction.name: SWE-rebench
extraction.description: A public dataset comprising over 21,000 interactive Python-based software engineering (SWE) tasks extracted automatically from diverse GitHub repositories, designed for reinforcement learning of SWE agents at scale and contamination-free benchmarking.
extraction.creator: Ibragim Badertdinov, Alexander Golubev, Maksim Nekrashevich, Anton Shevtsov, Simon Karasik, Andrei Andriushchenko, Maria Trofimova, Daria Litvintseva, Boris Yangel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data collection involves downloading raw issue and pull request data from GitHub Archive and cloning relevant GitHub repositories with full commit histories. PRs linked to resolved issues are filtered based on criteria including permissive repository license, Python percentage (>75%), file change counts (1 to 15 files), and presence of test modifications. Environments are set up automatically via an agentless LLM approach extracting recipes from repo files, verified inside containers, and annotated.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Pull requests linked to issues created before May 1, 2025 (with benchmark recency focusing on tasks created in 2025).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering to select instances where: repository is Python (>75% lines of code) with a permissive license; issue marked resolved; PR merged into main branch; PR not linked to multiple issues; issue description >10 characters; PR introduces or modifies tests and includes non-test code changes; changes affect 1 to 15 files. The patch is separated into a solution patch and a test patch. Instances undergo execution-based verification in Docker containers to verify fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass test conditions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automated quality assessment where an instruction-following model (Qwen 2.5-72B-Instruct) fine-tuned on human annotations from SWE-bench Verified predicts binary quality labels for Issue Clarity, Task Complexity, and Test Patch Correctness for each instance.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Continuously updated decontaminated evaluation benchmark maintained via a public leaderboard (https://swe-rebench.com/leaderboard), continuously tracking issue creation dates against model release dates.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Accelerates the development of autonomous AI systems in software engineering, which brings potential risks like overreliance on AI-generated code or misuse of automated agents for introducing vulnerabilities; fostering openness and standardized evaluations aims to mitigate these concerns.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Automated task quality assessment relies on heuristics and LLM predictions, meaning some tasks may be imperfectly described or unsolvable solely from the issue; prompt engineering for recipe generation was validated on limited repositories; the initial dataset is limited exclusively to Python.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training (specifically reinforcement learning and fine-tuning) and standardized, decontaminated benchmarking/evaluation of LLM-based software engineering agents.
